objective: Discover polymer-based solid electrolyte candidates for lithium batteries through condition-aware transfer of ionic-transport mechanisms.
queries: solid polymer electrolyte lithium ion transport
polymerized ionic liquid ion transport decoupling
polyether polymer segmental relaxation ion transport
polymer low glass transition segmental mobility
screening_policy: Include polymer systems with either transport evidence or structural/property clues. Structural hits are hypotheses, not established mechanisms. Polymer papers without these keywords go to manual review. Never infer suitability or novelty from keyword matches.
